description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and the loss ratio in percentage for five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a custom non-linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks specifically labeled at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The plot contains five solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape, as indicated by a legend in the bottom right. The purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers represents "Vanilla" and remains perfectly constant at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis. The orange line with vertical tick markers represents "SepLLM (n=64)"; it starts at approximately 98.3 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8 TFLOPs, and ends at 100 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The dark blue line with 'x' markers denotes "SepLLM (n=128)", beginning at 97.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increasing to 99.9 at 2e8 TFLOPs, and remaining relatively steady to finish at 99.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The green line with diamond markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", starts at 97.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs, generally increases to a peak of 100.2 at 6e8 TFLOPs, and concludes at 99.9 at 9e8 TFLOPs. Finally, the red line with circle markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)"; it begins at the lowest point of 94 at 1e7 TFLOPs, climbs to a peak of 99.1 at 4e8 TFLOPs, experiences a slight dip to 98.5 at 5e8 TFLOPs, and eventually ends at 98.7 at 9e8 TFLOPs.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)' and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', starting at about 97% and ending at 99%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at around 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
